images.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: finished architectural competition website cover, landscape 16:9. Input image 1 is the earlier finished concept rendering, a MATERIAL AND REALISM reference only. Input image 2 is the current geometry-derived aerial and is the AUTHORITATIVE EDIT TARGET. Render image 2 at professional architectural competition quality, with exactly its camera direction, perspective, building footprints, storeys, spacing, canopy routes, public facilities, service roads and solar-array positions. Preserve all geometry and relative scale. Improve only surface materials, realistic light and restrained human life. San Juan Argentine desert: pale mineral-plaster low-rise homes, gravel mineral ground, sparse dry-climate planting, continuous light shade structures, blue-black solar panels, broad dry landscape. Clear warm late-afternoon sunlight with readable shadows; restrained photorealism, no heavy atmosphere. Make the principal residential/public-space/production relationship immediately legible. No invented towers, courtyards, infill, buildings, hills, rivers, lakes, lawns or forests. Keep sparse arid planting. Compose a landscape image filling approximately the top 88% with a slim warm-white editorial title band below. The band must contain only these exact words: large 'AGUA FINITA' followed by '有限水城', and beneath it small '首期街区概念效果图'. Elegant dark-blue sans-serif typography. No logo, no old slogan, no charts or decorative graphics, no extra text. This is a conceptual rendering of the first neighbourhood, NOT a rendering of all 1656 square kilometres. Preserve geometry rather than beautifying through design changes.
